snippet.title: Club Soko - Cerebral Puzzle Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
From May 29th to June 5th, discover a curated selection thinky puzzle games within the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase — including our very own Club Soko!

Play the free demo now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3507130/Club_Soko_Demo/
Wishlist Club Soko: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346410/Club_Soko/

The official showcase livestream running May 29 – June 1, featuring streamers playing some of the best puzzle games around. More info on the event: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase?tab=2
